summary: Frontend-only test for new Section 04 Podcast on Portfolio site. All spec-defined data-testids, text content, images, CTAs, background color, and nav integration verified. Regression sections (hero, marquee, projects, footer) still render. No console errors observed.

issues: podcast-episode-figure measured ratio 1.777 vs expected 1.837 (diff 0.059); podcast-trailer-figure measured 1.463 vs expected 1.528 (diff 0.065). The bounding-box includes the caption label (e.g., 'EP. 03 · PASSION & FASHION' / 'TRAILER · ~ 00:45') rendered below the image, so the aspect-[2000/1089] and aspect-[2000/1309] classes technically apply to the image wrapper only. Images themselves render at correct natural sizes (2000x1089 and 2000x1309). Reporting as informational only — this is likely intentional editorial layout, but flagged because it fails the ±0.02 check in the spec if measured against the outer figure element.

critical_code_review_comments: Aspect-ratio spec check: if the ±0.02 tolerance on the outer figure is required, wrap the image in an inner div with the aspect-[] class and put the caption outside the aspect wrapper. Otherwise leave as-is (visual layout is correct).
